problem: The Storage stat card has sharp 2px corners (.stat-usage { border-radius: 2px }) while the other three stat cards use the 10px card radius.
done_when: The Storage card has the same corner radius as the other stat cards: the .stat-usage border-radius override is removed or set to var(--radius) / 10px. The other three cards are unchanged.

problem: In the Team profile form, 'Save changes' is styled as a secondary button, the same as 'Cancel'. The main action of the form should be the primary button.
done_when: The 'Save changes' button has class btn-primary (not btn-secondary). 'Cancel' stays secondary.

problem: The 'Invite member' button sits in a footer under the members table. It belongs in the Members card header, on the right of the 'Members' title.
done_when: The 'Invite member' button is inside .members .card-head (after the h2) and no longer in the card footer; the now-empty .card-foot is removed or at least holds no button. There is exactly one 'Invite member' button on the page.

problem: In the Mei Tanaka row the 'Pending' badge is in the Name cell and the Status cell is empty. In every other row the status badge is in the Status column.
done_when: In the Mei Tanaka row the 'Pending' badge span is inside the 4th cell (Status) and the Name cell holds only 'Mei Tanaka'. No other row changed.

done_when: The 'active' class is on the Team sidebar link and on no other .nav-item. The Projects link is still in the sidebar, just not active.

problem: The line under the page title is placeholder text ('Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet…').
done_when: The .lede paragraph still exists but no longer contains lorem ipsum; it holds one short real sentence that fits the page (about managing the team's members, profile or settings).

problem: The rows in the Notifications list have uneven height: 'Weekly summary' has 22px vertical padding and 'Storage alerts' has 4px, against 12px for the other two.
done_when: All four .row items in the Notifications list have the same vertical padding: the two inline padding overrides are removed (or all rows set to one equal value). The rows and their checkboxes are otherwise unchanged.

done_when: The field holding #timezone has a <label> before the select with text like 'Time zone' (ideally for="timezone"), styled like the other field labels (plain <label> inside .field).

problem: The top bar shows leftover debug text: 'build 0.9.3-dev · uid 4821'.
done_when: The .build span and its text are gone from the top bar. Logo, nav links and avatar are unchanged.

problem: The last card in the right column is an empty template card ('Card title' / 'Content goes here.').
done_when: The whole section with 'Card title' and 'Content goes here.' is removed. The Notifications and Plan cards remain.

problem: The 'Manage plan' link is magenta (#b5309f), a color used nowhere else. Links on this page (e.g. 'Edit' in the table) use the blue accent.
done_when: 'Manage plan' renders in the accent color: the .plan a color is var(--accent) / #2f6fed, or the color override is removed so it inherits the default link color. No magenta left in the file.

problem: The Team URL input is pushed 14px to the right (#team-url { margin-left: 14px }), so its left edge does not line up with its own label or with the fields above and below.
done_when: The #team-url input has no left margin (rule removed or set to 0), so it starts at the same left edge as the Team name input and the time zone select. Its width and the other fields are unchanged.
